svg.title: V-18. Timing budgets · FTTI, detection and reaction (SysML v2 view timingBudgets)
svg.desc: Timing budgets view generated from the SysML v2 model. One row per budget of WP-S-04 §3.7: the safety goals it serves, the fault detection (FDTI) and reaction (FRTI) budgets as bars on a 0 to 1.2 s axis against the FTTI, with the margin left; rows whose cells are not all times are given as text. On the right the TSRs the row names and the elements that satisfy them in the model.
